question: Which sacred materials complete the adornment of the depicted divine form?
premises: A neck-garland is made of rudraksha beads.
Sacred ash is applied as an adorning substance.
Both elements together characterize the form as adorned.
inference: The divine form is fully adorned with a rudraksha neck-garland and sacred ash.
plain_english: Adorned with a neck-garland of rudraksha beads and with sacred ash.
